ambientAuthority.statement: No isolation provider, capability policy engine or merge gate exists in this repository. A node executor runs with the ambient authority of the host process, and the Graph IR resources and isolation fields remain opaque declarations. Every case in this corpus describes required behaviour, never observed behaviour.
